experimental_method: Water content of CO2-rich gas or liquid sampled from a rotating autoclave (Galloway apparatus, tandem circulation pump, constant-temperature air bath), analysed with the Bloch and Lifland modified chromatographic technique; equilibrium with liquid water, ice or hydrate.
uncertainties_stated: not stated in the paper text read (no table of uncertainties found)
quality_remarks: Authors note sampling and analysis are difficult at low water concentration; up to 30 successive samples used to confirm elimination of metastable liquid water; later conditions chosen in the direction of increasing water concentration. Three rows (300 psia, 0.0, 2.5, 15.56 C) are taken from Ref. 4 (Kobayashi et al. 1979). Hydrate-region rows are measured in presence of hydrate (partly metastable-free). Table values are f_L x 10^3 mole fraction of water.
